summary: Comprehensive testing of SuperApp multi-service platform after bug fixes. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing shows most features working correctly. Key fixes verified: Admin dashboard now returns real stats (not 403), Food page shows 3 real restaurants from DB, Cart add/remove works, Wallet page loads with balance and top-up options. One UI issue found: Checkout page content not rendering properly (shows only header).

ui_bugs.issue: Checkout page content not rendering - shows only 'Checkout' header but no form fields, cart items, or place order button visible. Cart data exists in localStorage but page content doesn't display.
